entries.proposition: SYSTEM: all lines from ATCC and DNA-fingerprinted; main model MCF10 (called normal, immortalised). DATO.
entries.snippet: All cell lines were obtained from the American Type Culture Collection (ATCC, Manassas, VA, USA) and validated by DNA fingerprinting.

entries.proposition: KNOCKDOWN TEXT: 80-90% reduction of WWOX protein in all three stable lines. DATO as printed.
entries.snippet: All three stably WWOX-silenced cell lines showed a decrease of 80-90% WWOX protein expression levels (Figure 1A).
entries.anchor: Results > WWOX silencing affects clonal growth, paragraph 1

entries.proposition: FIGURE 1A, NATIVE PIXELS. No residual WWOX band is visible in shWWOX, shWWOX-A or shWWOX-B at this exposure, and no quantification is shown, so '80-90%' has no displayed basis (it may understate the knockdown). Actin even.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 1A: WWOX band present only in the Scr lane; shWWOX, shWWOX-A and shWWOX-B lanes blank; ACTIN even across four lanes.

entries.proposition: FIGURE 1 LEGEND: clonal-growth bars are the mean of three independent experiments +/- SEM. DATO as legend.
entries.snippet: Bar graph represents the average of three independent experiments +/- SEM.

entries.proposition: FIGURE 1B-C, NATIVE PIXELS. B: average colony area Scr about 120 vs shWWOX about 283; the shWWOX bar has no visible SEM bar (implausible for three independent experiments unless near-identical), only the pooled shWWOX line is plotted (not A or B separately), and colony number is not shown although the text says it did not differ. C: wound closure about 17 vs 47.5, SEM shown. No test is named for B or C.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 1B-C: B average colony area Scr about 120 with small error bar and shWWOX about 283 with no visible error bar; C delta area fraction Scr about 17 and shWWOX about 47.5 with error bars.

entries.proposition: PROLIFERATION IS INFERRED FROM COLONY SIZE: no difference in colony number, larger colonies, 'proliferate more rapidly'. DATO as wording; 'more rapidly' is an INFERENZA from colony area, not a growth-curve measurement.
entries.snippet: We did not detect differences in clonogenicity (i.e. number of colonies) but found that MCF10 WWOX-silenced cells proliferate more rapidly forming larger colonies
entries.anchor: Results > WWOX silencing affects clonal growth, paragraph 2

entries.proposition: ATTACHMENT TEXT: decreased attachment to laminin, collagen IV and fibronectin (Additional file 1). DATO as printed.
entries.snippet: WWOX-silenced cells also displayed decreased attachment to extracellular matrix components such as laminin, collagen IV and fibronectin (Additional file 1)
entries.anchor: Results > WWOX silencing affects clonal growth, paragraph 2

entries.proposition: ADDITIONAL FILE 1, NATIVE PIXELS. Three time courses (0-120 min, x axis spaced categorically although intervals are 15 then 30 min), y axis labelled '% attachment' but scaled 0-1.25 as a fraction. Dashed shWWOX below solid Scr at most time points, gap largest on collagen IV (about 1.0 vs 0.81 at 120 min); on laminin the curves converge (1.0 vs 0.87 with overlapping bars). Legend: two independent experiments in quadruplicate, SEM; no statistical test anywhere.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Additional file 1: panels A laminin, B collagen IV, C fibronectin; solid Scr above dashed shWWOX, largest gap in B, overlapping error bars at 120 minutes in A; y axis 0 to 1.25.

entries.proposition: ADDITIONAL FILE 1 LEGEND, supplement surface: two experiments in quadruplicate, SEM. DATO.
entries.snippet: data points represent the average of two independent experiments done in quadruplicate

entries.proposition: ARRAY OVERLAP TEXT: 328 commonly up and 344 commonly down (q < 0.05). DATO as printed.
entries.snippet: identified 328 commonly up-modulated and 344 commonly down-modulated genes (q value < 0.05) in the two WWOX stably silenced cell lines (Figure 2A)

entries.proposition: ADDITIONAL FILE 2, PARSED: the UP sheet holds 328 rows and the DOWN sheet 344, matching 328 and 344 and the Venn intersections. Mean of the sh-A and sh-B fold changes for the four named SMAD3 targets: FST 5.19, PTHLH 3.66, ANGPTL4 3.55, SERPINE1 2.54 (text: FST 5.2, PTHLH 3.6, ANGPTL4 3.5, SERPINE1 2.5). DATO computed from the supplement.
entries.snippet: ## sheet: shWWOX-A & shWWOX-B q<0.05 UPs

entries.proposition: FIGURE 2C LEGEND: the bars are the four transcription factors with the highest combined scores. DATO as legend.
entries.snippet: Bars represent the four transcription factors with the highest combined scores calculated by the Enrichr resource

entries.proposition: ADDITIONAL FILE 2, ChEA SHEET PARSED - SMAD3 IS NOT IN THE TOP FOUR. Ranked by combined score the sheet gives E2F4 (human), SOX2 (human), MYC (mouse) 71.85, E2F1 (human), SOX2 (mouse), E2F1 (mouse), then SMAD3-18955504 (human) at rank 7 (54.78), tied with SMAD2 from the same ChIP study. Figure 2C shows E2F4, SOX2, E2F1 and SMAD3 - the top four HUMAN entries, a filter the legend does not declare. DATO computed.
entries.anchor: Additional file 2, sheet 'ChIP Enrichment Analysis', SMAD3-18955504 row (derived text)

entries.proposition: FIGURE 2, NATIVE PIXELS. A: up 203 | 328 | 221, down 152 | 344 | 234, overlap p<0.0001, matching the text. C: E2F4 combined score about 227 (p=2.16e-38), SOX2 about 141 (p=2.10e-40), E2F1 about 57 (p=1.77e-16), SMAD3 about 55 (p=5.83e-18); SMAD3 is the lowest of the four shown. B: IPA biofunctions, cell cycle/organisation/DNA replication about 17 (-log p).
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 2: Venn diagrams 203 328 221 and 152 344 234; ChEA bars E2F4 p=2.16e-38, SOX2 p=2.10e-40, E2F1 p=1.77e-16, SMAD3 p=5.83e-18 in decreasing combined score.

entries.proposition: TEXT/LEGEND: significant upregulation of all targets in all silenced lines except PTHLH in MCF7. DATO as printed.
entries.snippet: Significant upregulation was seen for all target genes in all WWOX-silenced samples with the exception of PTHLH expression in MCF7 cells.

entries.proposition: FIGURE 3, NATIVE PIXELS - PTHLH IN MCF7 GOES THE OTHER WAY. C: PTHLH relative expression about 0.05 in shWWOX-B MCF7 against 1.0 in Scr, a roughly 20-fold DECREASE, not a failure to increase. B (184B5): ANGPTL4 only about 1.55. A (MCF10 qPCR): ANGPTL4 about 4.5, FST about 7.8, PTHLH about 11, SERPINE1 about 4.0, all larger than the array folds. D: ANGPTL4 about 14.5 vs 42.5 ng/mL; E: FST about 0.5 vs 73 ng/mL. F: dox re-expression lowers the four transcripts to about 0.63, 0.40, 0.41, 0.35. Each 184B5 and MCF7 result is one shRNA (shWWOX-B).
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 3: C MCF7 PTHLH white bar about 0.05 against black 1.0; B 184B5 ANGPTL4 about 1.55; A MCF10 ANGPTL4 4.5 FST 7.8 PTHLH 11 SERPINE1 4.0; F black bars 0.63 0.40 0.41 0.35.
entries.qualifies_needle: exception of PTHLH expression in MCF7

entries.proposition: REPORTER TEXT: WWOX 'significantly quenched' TGF-beta-dependent luciferase. DATO as printed.
entries.snippet: we found that dox-inducible expression of WWOX protein in MCF10 cells significantly quenched TGFβ-dependent luciferase expression (Figure 4A)
entries.anchor: Results > WWOX inhibits TGF-beta induced transcriptional activation, paragraph 1

entries.proposition: FIGURE 4A, NATIVE PIXELS. Relative luciferase about 34 (no TGF, no WWOX), 91.5 (TGF), 26 (WWOX), 37.5 (TGF + WWOX). WWOX also lowers the basal signal; no statistical test is shown or named for this panel ('Experiment done in triplicate'); the dox-alone control for a doxycycline effect is not shown.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 4A: relative luciferase bars about 34, 91.5, 26 and 37.5 for TGFb1 minus/plus and WWOX minus/plus combinations; no significance marks.

entries.proposition: ChIP TEXT: WWOX lowers SMAD3 promoter occupancy both at rest and after TGF-beta. DATO as printed.
entries.snippet: WWOX protein expression affects SMAD3 protein availability for binding effector promoter elements both in the idle state and upon TGFβ1 stimulation
entries.anchor: Results > WWOX inhibits TGF-beta induced transcriptional activation, paragraph 2

entries.proposition: FIGURE 4B-C, NATIVE PIXELS. ANGPTL4 promoter: SMAD3 %input about 2.4 (basal) and 14 (TGF) without WWOX, about 0.45 in both WWOX conditions - while the IgG control in the TGF + WWOX condition reads about 1.1, ABOVE the SMAD3 signal with WWOX. SERPINE1: SMAD3 about 1.8 and 10.6 without WWOX, about 0.75 with WWOX; IgG about 0. So with WWOX the ANGPTL4 SMAD3 signal is at or below background. Error bars are SD with n not stated; the TGF-only SMAD3 bars show no visible error.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 4B-C: pANGPTL4 SMAD3 bars about 2.4, 0.45, 14 and 0.45 with IgG white bar about 1.1 in the WWOX plus TGFb1 condition; pSERPINE1 SMAD3 bars about 1.8, 0.75, 10.6 and 0.75 with IgG near zero.

entries.proposition: PREMISE CITED: WW1 is a class I WW domain binding PPXY independently of phosphorylation (refs 25, 30). DATO about the citations.
entries.snippet: The first WW domain of WWOX is a Class I WW domain known to bind to PPXY motifs on target proteins in a phosphorylation-independent manner
entries.anchor: Results > WWOX interacts with SMAD3 via WW domain 1

entries.proposition: PULL-DOWN TEXT: SMAD3 binding is lost with WW1 mutated (W44F/P47A). DATO as printed.
entries.snippet: readily binds to the wild type WW domains of WWOX but the interaction is lost when the first WW domain is mutated (W44F/P47A)
entries.anchor: Results > WWOX interacts with SMAD3 via WW domain 1

entries.proposition: FIGURE 5A-B, NATIVE PIXELS. B: SMAD3 band strong with GST-WT, absent with GST, and a WEAK BUT VISIBLE band with GST-mut1 - binding reduced, not abolished. No Coomassie or Ponceau of the GST proteins is shown, so equal bait loading is not demonstrated; SMAD3 is transfected Flag-SMAD3 (overexpressed). A: endogenous co-IP, WWOX IP brings down SMAD3 and SMAD3 IP brings down WWOX; a faint SMAD3 signal is present in the IgG lane. One blot each, no replicate count.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 5A-B: B IB SMAD3 bands in input, GST-WT strong, GST-mut1 weak, GST none; A IB SMAD3 bands in SMAD3, WWOX, RUNX2 IP lanes and input with a faint band in IgG; IB WWOX bands in SMAD3, WWOX, RUNX2 IP lanes and input.
entries.qualifies_needle: interaction is lost when the first WW domain

entries.proposition: CONFOCAL TEXT: WWOX induction redistributes SMAD3 from nucleus to cytoplasm. DATO as printed. The Methods and legend describe TRANSIENT pcDNA-Myc-WWOX transfection, not dox induction.
entries.snippet: induction of WWOX expression led to a cellular redistribution of SMAD3 protein levels shifting from the nuclear to the cytoplasmic compartment
entries.anchor: Results > WWOX expression induces intracellular SMAD3 redistribution

entries.proposition: FIGURE 5C, NATIVE PIXELS. One field: a single Myc-WWOX-positive cell whose SMAD3 signal is weak and diffuse with no bright nucleus, beside untransfected cells with bright nuclear SMAD3. No cell counts, no quantification of nuclear/cytoplasmic ratio, no statement of how many cells or experiments. Illustrative, n = 1 cell on the page.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 5C: SMAD3 green bright in several untransfected nuclei; the single red Myc-WWOX cell shows weak diffuse green without a bright nucleus; merge with DAPI; scale bars 20 um.
entries.qualifies_needle: shifting from the nuclear to the cytoplasmic
